mini_quadrumvirate.prediction: A wrong packed K stride, affine grouping, row/rank dispatch, or compiler mode could imitate a local match; a local pass could hide final-sum cancellation.
mini_quadrumvirate.question: Does reproducing MLX lane arithmetic remove the down discrepancy on exactly the same activation and weights, and does the full gate then pass?
mini_quadrumvirate.move: Separate opt-in native Metal kernel; exact-input native/candidate/repeat/scalar arms, passive full GPU trace, original comparator and bounded MoE replay.
mini_quadrumvirate.attack: Audit found k/8 versus k/2 byte stride before GPU execution; fixed. Synthetic periodic fixture and affine-offset assertions strengthened before tests. Real full gate retained as falsifier.

refuted_routes.pivot: Change harness depth only; depth2 exits1 for two actual final-MoE failures

mini_quadrumvirate.scope: Measured local down reproduction and bounded negative full gate; a full-parity claim is VULNERABLE and rejected.

mini_quadrumvirate.limitations: Exactly representable synthetic fixtures establish indexing/offsets, not general rounding equivalence. Source expressions/simd_sum are not a disassembly or hardware-tree proof.
